per_case.question: What was our total booking revenue in October, and how many confirmed bookings did we have?
per_case.answer: Total booking revenue in October was $3,608, from 109 confirmed bookings.
per_case.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(price_cents) / 100.0, 2) AS booking_revenue_usd, COUNT(*) AS confirmed_bookings FROM analyst.bookings WHERE club_id = 1 AND status = 'confirmed' AND starts_at >= '2026-10-01' AND starts_at < '2026-11-01'

per_case.question: Who were our top 3 members by number of bookings in September?
per_case.answer: The top 3 members by bookings in September were Blake Kowal with 13, Xen Ostrow with 7, and Vale Quade with 6.
per_case.sql: SELECT p.display_name, COUNT(*) AS booking_count FROM analyst.bookings b JOIN analyst.profiles p ON p.user_id = b.user_id WHERE b.club_id = 1 AND b.starts_at >= '2026-09-01' AND b.starts_at < '2026-10-01' AND b.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY b.user_id, p.display_name ORDER BY booking_count DESC LIMIT 3

per_case.question: What share of our bookings were no-shows?

per_case.question: Which of our courts gets booked the most? Count all bookings, including cancelled ones.
per_case.answer: Court 1 at Riverside Racquet Club (tennis) gets booked the most, with 95 bookings including cancelled ones. Court 2 follows with 93 and Court 3 with 89.
per_case.sql: SELECT c.name AS court_name, cl.name AS club_name, c.sport, COUNT(b.id) AS booking_count FROM analyst.courts c JOIN analyst.clubs cl ON cl.id = c.club_id LEFT JOIN analyst.bookings b ON b.court_id = c.id WHERE c.club_id = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.name, cl.name, c.sport ORDER BY booking_count DESC
